name: browser-use
headline: AI coding editors by price
short_description: A curated list of AI-powered CLI, code editors, and IDEs sorted by minimal plan price. Helps developers and operations teams select cost-effective tools for coding tasks. Integrates with Claude for AI assistance.
author: dalisoft

sections.overview:
awesome-ai-coding is a curated directory that lists AI-powered code editors, IDEs, CLI tools, and extensions organized by minimal subscription price. The resource helps developers and operations teams evaluate and select cost-effective AI coding tools by comparing pricing plans, trial availability, usage limits, and open-source options. It includes detailed information on providers like Claude Code, Cursor, Zed, and others, making it easier to identify tools that fit specific budgets and requirements. Whether you're looking for token-based or subscription-based AI coding assistants, this directory provides transparent pricing and feature comparison across multiple categories.
Comparing AI code editor pricing across Claude Code, Cursor, and Zed
Finding open-source AI coding tools with bring-your-own-key options
Evaluating subscription costs and usage limits for coding assistants
Researching free trial availability for AI-powered IDEs
